about: Maps whose background in public/maps is a delivered painting, not a placeholder. scripts/gen-background.py skips these (use --force to paint the placeholder over one). The editable layered sources (.ora) and lossless masters live with the art drops, not in the repo. Since v0.15.2 every map is encoded from the drop's lossless master at JPEG quality 85.
